interpretation: Self sample weights sum V8 timeDeltas at each sampled leaf. Inclusive calltree weights retain actual parent ancestry and overlap; they are not additive. Idle/GC/native/generated frames remain explicit. Sampling and start/stop overhead prevent treating these weights as exact CPU durations; generated or library frames are not reassigned to callers. No separate Workerd, PostgreSQL/server, allocation or async-wait attribution is inferred.
